newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Tuesday, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.
That follows Monday's operation of 10-day fixed system RPs.
Federal funds were trading at 5-5/16 percent, above the 5-1/4 percent target rate, when the Fed entered the open market.
System RPs were generally expected, although some analysts had forecast customer RPs. -- N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1867
